methods.name: Uni-3D
methods.description: Proposed system with single- or multi-scale feature lifting able to accurately generate instance geometry and scene layouts.

methods.name: Pano-Re
methods.description: Baseline framework able to accurately generate instance geometry and scene layouts.

methods.name: Mesh R-CNN
methods.description: Baseline method that tends to generate noisy reconstructed shapes.

methods.name: Total3D
methods.description: Baseline method that predicts shape-based instance category priors, resulting in inconsistency between shapes and 2D observations.

methods.name: ResNet-18
methods.description: Backbone feature extractor

methods.name: depth-aware panoptic segmentation framework
methods.description: 2D network substituting Pano-Re's 2D network

methods.name: Multi-scale Feature Lifting
methods.description: Back-projection of multi-scale 2D features and fusing them into U-Net encoders to leverage richer semantics

methods.name: U-Net encoders
methods.description: Encoders used to fuse back-projected multi-scale 2D features

methods.name: semantic segmentation
methods.description: Used in 3D to solve segmentation tasks.

methods.name: back-projection
methods.description: A technique relying on depth accuracy to project 2D information into 3D.

methods.name: 3D panoptic reconstruction network
methods.description: Loads and freezes weights of the 2D network, trained with voxel-based representations evaluated via PRQ metric.

methods.name: marching cubes algorithm
methods.description: Extracts the isosurface from the predicted TDF as meshes and assigns each vertex a color.

methods.name: Dual decoders
methods.description: Dual decoders for panoptic segmentation and depth estimation using masked cross-attention, cross-decoder query association, and self-attention layers.

methods.name: Cross-decoder query association
methods.description: Layer enabling communication between segment and depth queries belonging to the same segment.

methods.name: 3D generative U-Net
methods.description: Generative U-Net used for 3D scene reconstruction processing features encoded in a volumetric grid.

methods.name: AdamW optimizer
methods.description: Used to optimize the 2D network

methods.name: Nearest neighbor interpolation
methods.description: Down-samples the ground truth to 1/4 of original image size to match predicted depth maps

methods.name: Polynomial-based learning rate scheduler
methods.description: Multiplies base learning rate by (1−i/N)^0.9

methods.name: Data augmentation
methods.description: Random scaling from 0.5 to 2.0 of original size (320x240), fixed-size crop to 240x240, and color augmentations

methods.name: depth DF embedding
methods.description: Regarding the depth as a distance field embedding incorporated into the 3D network

methods.name: learned 2D queries
methods.description: Learned 2D queries qS i affecting object instances in 3D

methods.name: 2D features ablation
methods.description: Ablating the model by removing 2D features (mask feature PS(F4) and depth feature PD(F4)) or replacing learned 2D queries with randomly initialized learnable query embeddings

methods.name: 2D segmentation masks as priors
methods.description: Using 2D semantic segmentation maps as priors (equivalent to instance propagation) back-projected to improve 3D results

methods.name: Transformer-based architecture
methods.description: Simultaneously addresses panoptic segmentation and depth estimation.

methods.name: 3D network for panoptic reconstruction
methods.description: Takes in back-projected multi-scale features and transforms them into 3D segments with query embeddings for reconstruction output.

methods.name: Mask2Former
methods.description: Formulates panoptic segmentation as a mask classification task by partitioning an image into N regions represented by binary masks.
